speaker: Doctor
text: That seems like a significant amount of time; have you noticed any blood in your sputum, weight loss, or night sweats recently? Also, do you have a history of smoking or exposure to asbestos or other industrial dusts?

speaker: Patient
text: No, I have never seen any blood in my spit, and I haven't lost weight or had night sweats. I've never smoked in my life and don't work with any industrial dusts; I'm just a school teacher. speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Pneumonia (bilateral ground-glass opacities). Given your occupation as a school teacher, have you recently had close contact with anyone with a confirmed respiratory infection, or do you have a history of autoimmune conditions like scleroderma or sarcoidosis?

DIAGNOSIS_READY_Answer: Chronic Cough secondary to Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease (GERD)
